dataset.name: Primary TNBC spatial-immunophenotype Cohort A2 (GSE177043)
dataset.description: Independent primary triple-negative breast-cancer cohort with public bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study profiled 43 untreated primary triple-negative breast cancers in RNA-seq validation Cohort A2. The public article workbook links 41 expression columns to exact overall-survival time and event status; two RNA profiles without an individual clinical row are excluded before analysis.

metadata.source_program: Primary TNBC spatial-immunophenotype RNA-seq validation Cohort A2
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Europe PMC
metadata.library_method: Whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing of untreated primary triple-negative breast tumors; GEO reports STAR 2.4.2a alignment to GRCh38, geTMM normalization and source log2 transformation.
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival in months for the source Cohort A patients
metadata.endpoint_definition_note: The public clinical workbook supplies OS duration in months and the binary osi indicator, where 1 denotes death and 0 denotes censoring. The associated article explicitly labels the survival time scale as months.
metadata.sample_linkage_note: GEO sample titles are the Cohort A2 identifiers used as expression-matrix columns and in the sampleCohortA2 clinical-workbook field. This provides deterministic expression-to-endpoint linkage without positional matching.
metadata.sample_selection_note: All 43 GEO records are source-designated primary TNBC tumors and map one-to-one to expression columns. Forty-one have a linked positive OS time and explicit event status; JA074 and X1966 lack a public individual clinical row and are excluded.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The public matrix contains 58,381 rows, an Ensembl identifier column, a source gene-symbol column and 43 source log2-normalized expression columns. TRACE Explorer selects the 41 endpoint-complete columns, excludes 33,929 symbols with a source NA in at least one retained tumor and excludes all 1,737 rows belonging to 186 case-insensitive duplicated symbols, leaving 22,897 complete non-ambiguous symbols. Negative source-normalized values are retained and no imputation or additional transformation is applied.
metadata.overlap_note: Cohort A2 is independent of TCGA-BRCA. Its source-local sample identifiers and untreated primary-TNBC design are distinct from the other breast-cancer cohorts currently promoted in the repository.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Direct source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the article's CC BY 4.0 license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: One source-designated untreated primary triple-negative breast tumor per patient

expression.label: GEO source-provided log2-normalized expression
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Every row belonging to a symbol represented more than once under case-insensitive comparison is excluded rather than silently aggregated. Rows containing a source NA in any retained endpoint-complete tumor are also excluded without imputation.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer preserves the source log2-normalized values, including negative values, after deterministic endpoint-column selection and complete, non-ambiguous symbol filtering. Values support within-cohort analyses and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause according to source osi=1; osi=0 denotes censoring
